impact.text: the V2 buyback path has no effective pre-swap price validation

precondition_sources.text: buyBack() has no access control and is callable by anyone.

intent_sources.text: _validatePrice() must protect the buyback mechanism from price manipulation by comparing the current spot price against a time-weighted average price derived from two snapshots taken at different points in time.
